high_level_overview.overview: The POSTTRAN job processes a daily transaction file for a credit card system (CardDemo), validating and loading transactions into a master VSAM transaction file while updating transaction category balances. It cross-references card data to validate transactions against account records, rejecting any invalid transactions into a daily rejects file for further review. The overall business purpose is to perform end-of-day transaction posting, ensuring all daily credit card transactions are accurately recorded, categorized, and reflected in the appropriate account balances.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The JOB statement marks the beginning of a job and assigns it the name POSTTRAN. This name is used to identify the job in the system and in job logs.

parameters.name: ACCT
parameters.description: The accounting information parameter provides billing or accounting data associated with the job. Here it is set to 'POSTTRAN', which may be used for charge-back or tracking purposes.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class, which determines the initiator queue the job is submitted to. CLASS=A assigns the job to job class A, influencing scheduling priority and resource allocation.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log (JES message log). MSGCLASS=0 directs the job's system messages and JCL listing to output class 0, determining where the job log is routed for printing or viewing.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified when the job completes. &SYSUID is a symbolic parameter that resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, so that user receives a notification upon job completion or failure.

job_details.purpose: Processes the daily transaction file by reading each transaction, validating it against the card cross-reference and account data, posting accepted transactions to the transaction master VSAM file and updating transaction category balances, while writing rejected transactions to a new daily rejects dataset.
job_details.inputs: DALYTRAN (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYTRAN.PS) - daily transaction flat file; TRANFILE (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) - transaction master VSAM KSDS; XREFFILE (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS) - card cross-reference VSAM KSDS; ACCTFILE (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS) - account data VSAM KSDS; TCATBALF (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS) - transaction category balance VSAM KSDS
job_details.outputs: DALYREJS (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS(+1)) - new generation of daily rejected transactions file (RECFM=F, LRECL=430), cataloged on success, deleted on failure; TRANFILE (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) - updated with posted transactions; TCATBALF (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS) - updated transaction category balances; SYSPRINT, SYSOUT

data_operations.description: Load library used to fetch the executable program CBTRN02C for execution
Daily transaction flat file (physical sequential) read as input to process daily transactions
Transaction master VSAM KSDS file updated with processed daily transaction records
Card cross-reference VSAM KSDS file read to resolve card number to account number mappings during transaction processing
Account data VSAM KSDS file read and updated with balance changes resulting from processed transactions
Transaction category balance VSAM KSDS file read and updated to accumulate balance totals by transaction category

New generation of daily rejected transactions GDG dataset created and written with transaction records that failed validation or processing; fixed format RECFM=F, LRECL=430, allocated on SYSDA with 1 cylinder primary and 1 cylinder secondary space
